checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: First image retains silhouette, matte black finish, lid details on white
must.why: Shape and lid are close, white bg; slightly glossier highlights and the bottle looks a bit regenerated, but largely retained.

must.item: No table or original background in first image
Second image realistic, same bottle upright on rock by lake at sunrise
must.why: Bottle on rock, lake, sunrise glow; the cap is simplified (no open loop top) and the bottle is a silhouette.

faults.what: Image 1 bottle appears regenerated: added soft specular highlights, slightly different proportions, and a faint haze at the edges.
Image 2 bottle cap lacks the original open loop detail and is a flat silhouette, so it only loosely matches the source.
Image 2 bottle is darkly backlit and the scene looks slightly AI-painterly.

summary: Both square images meet the brief, with a clean white-background bottle and a convincing sunrise lake scene, but the bottle is slightly altered in image 1 and its cap detail is lost in image 2.
